_readme: FIAT RUN EVENTS (BUILD46-E, 2 Nov; docs/design/run_events.md): 38 jobs, $3.04 - a rival crew a zone standing, two dogs standing, firing and going down; the one in need a zone, down and up; the Scrap man and the Vagabond at their barrows; nine props shut and open. The test's four are the same jobs (skipped once on disk).
Run: tools\art.bat run_events (the dry run first, then it asks).
Every job is generate-image-v2 at 65k px or under: $0.08 a job (docs/art/pixellab_lessons.md).
event_prop.gd finds each by name (art/events/<name>.png) and draws the slice's shapes where one isn't on disk.
Regenerate with python3 tools/make_run_events_manifest.py; check with python3 tools/art_lint.py.

One person alone, full body head to feet, facing the viewer, centred, filling the frame top to bottom, plain dark neutral background.
